department: Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences

deadline.value: January 15 for Fall 2027, for Canadian and international applicants.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for the Fall semester (beginning in September) is January 15. | These deadlines are the same for both Canadian and international applicants.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Earth & Planetary Sciences does not require a GRE as part of the graduate application.

supervisor.value: A faculty member must formally commit to supervise and fund you; contact faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: students will not be accepted without having a formal commitment from a faculty member stating his or her intention to supervise and fund the research work

funding.value: Students get a guaranteed package (tuition subsidies plus research stipend), with TA work on top, subject to satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: guaranteed funding (tuition subsidies, research stipend) for progress towards your degree

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD with or without an MSc; without one you take a year of courses first.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the Ph.D. program without an M.Sc. are required to take a full year of courses before embarking on the processes described above.
